descriptionHtml: "Fastora '25 - Ignite the Future of Connectivity" is an event organized by the IEEE WIE student branch affinity group of the University of Peradeniya. The event was held on 10th of February 2025, from 11:30 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Peradeniya. This insightful session was conducted on the fundamentals of 5G technology and its transformative potential in industrial Applications. The lecture was delivered by renowned telecommunications expert Eng. Anuradha Udunuwara, who brought deep insights into the evolution of mobile networks and how 5G stands as a transformative force in modern industries. The talk was followed by an engaging Q&A session, allowing attendees to ask questions and connect directly with the speaker, making it a valuable learning experience for everyone involved.
venue: AR Building, Faculty of Engineering., Seminar room 01, Faculty of Engineering,
